_target: its own file (Encounter, biomes W3): it was drafted as a block 'biome' of data/director/launch.json, and is moved here from docs/combat/pending/biomes/launch.biome.json with its schema tools/schemas/combat-launch-biome.schema.json (from the draft fragment director-launch-biome.fragment.json). DirData.dataHash() folds this file's text into the replay's data hash, as it does launch.json's
_about: Combat's (2026-10-23; built by Encounter in biomes W3; docs/combat/biomes.md section 3). RULED by Game Design (docs/design/rulings-2026-10-23b.md item 1): the values accepted as a set, with the rules below. Launch-planner terms by biome and surface for sim/director/launch.gd chooseLaunch: eight scored candidates that use the ground (a cliff, ice to skid on, a marsh that swallows a slam, trees to smash through, a skim ashore, a slope, a vent, a big prop), terms on the landing's surface, and two biome tables that replace hard-coded numbers. Every score is in the planner's points and is a first value for Game Design. The planner's shared terms (noise, care at the landing, distance, new biome, water, repeats, launch anywhere's freshness) apply to every new candidate as to SMASH ACROSS; a new candidate is never offered when its feature is missing, so a biome without it plays exactly as today. A candidate's hero and villain are added by personality as interiorAim's score is (the care's sign, or the role at care 0). Lengths are in body heights (75 units). With enabled false nothing is offered or added. The block rides launch.json, which DirLaunch.dataText() already folds into the replay's data hash.

rules.stickWins: the biome terms never outweigh town.stickWins, and a held stick's kind (up, down, across) is never changed
rules.freshByKind: launch anywhere's freshness reads each candidate by the kind of its sends list: CLIFFSIDE, ICE SKID, TREE LINE, SKIM ASHORE, DOWNHILL and PROP SMASH across, MARSH SWALLOW down, VENT LIFT up
rules.personality: the care term at the landing decides, as on every candidate; each candidate's hero and villain bonus is accepted as flavour (23b item 6)

qa._ruled: QA's bands, 23b item 1: each candidate taken in 5 to 30% of the launches where it is offered; none over 40% of launches inside its own biome; launches landing in the sea fall with SKIM ASHORE on

biome._touchBuilt: the surfaceLand rows for today's classes (sand, rubble) apply only when this is true, so with the block on a world without the new biomes still plays as today

downBonus._about: added to DRIVE DOWN's score when the target is over this biome. Replaces launch.gd's hard-coded 'bio == forest: + 8', so forest's row keeps today's number

distMul._about: times the distance term (DIST_W) when the predicted landing is in this biome: open country rewards the long haul, closed country shortens it. Missing biomes read 1

surfaceLand._about: added by the send's kind (up, down, across, from launch.gd SENDS) when the predicted landing's surface is this class (World's surfaceAt). soft: the impact's damage times this (a soft landing hurts less and digs less). Missing classes add nothing

CLIFFSIDE._about: MOUNTAINSIDE for any biome: the first rise ahead steeper than minTan over at least minRiseBh, out to reachBh, found from heights (WorldTerrain.groundY), not from a biome name. The landing is the face: the slide's WALL stop or an embed. MOUNTAINSIDE keeps the mountains biome, so a face inside mountains is not offered twice
CLIFFSIDE.where: highland crags, volcanic cones, sea cliffs, the ice shelf's 36-unit edge (0.5 bh: too low, so not offered there), tundra's heaved plates when 2 bh or more

ICE SKID._about: a flat, low send onto ice: the body skids far for little force. Offered when the ground within onIceBh of the target is ice. The slide reads World's ice brake, so its length is World's; the planner's predicted travel reads that brake too. Ruled (23b item 2): the slide stays ice's length, but he has control again where the same send would have stopped on rock (brake 0.8, ground_atoms.json skidStop.ice controlAtBrake); the rest is a skate he can act out of

endBonus._note: a skid that ends in a lead of open water (he goes in) or against a berg (a ricochet plant) scores this more; the water penalty is waived for a skid that ends in a lead

ICE SKID.where: sea ice, ice sheet glaze (ICEFIELD THAW's strip), frozen lakes if World adds them

MARSH SWALLOW._about: a slam straight down into mud: the marsh swallows him. Offered when the target is over mud within maxAltBh. It always embeds: the one deliberate embed (23b item 3), bounded by how often it is chosen. The body sits embedMul times as deep (World's embed, its 60-tick down state unchanged), the crater refills (ground_atoms.json craters.mud), and little is destroyed, so the carer likes it
MARSH SWALLOW.where: wetland; beach mudflats if World makes them mud

TREE LINE._about: a low send through a stand of trees: each trunk on the path snaps and slows him, the way BUILDING SMASH chains buildings. Offered when at least minTrees trunks stand on the predicted line within the send's first reachBh
TREE LINE.where: forest, jungle, taiga; savanna's lone trees count one each

SKIM ASHORE._about: from over water, a low send that skims and comes ashore: World's water skim already bounces a fast flat body (contact.json water). Offered when the target is over water and the predicted path skims at most maxSkims times and lands on dry ground within landBh. It takes the water penalty off and pays score instead, so fights over the sea come back to land (the old ocean-heavy launch mix)
SKIM ASHORE.where: beach, ocean next to land, wetland channels, sea ice leads

DOWNHILL._about: a send down the slope on the far side: he tumbles down it. Offered when the ground falls at least minDropBh within dropRunBh ahead and the slope's surface is one that tumbles or rolls
DOWNHILL.where: highland, mountains' flanks, volcanic cones, SCREE RUN's strip

VENT LIFT._about: an uppercut over a vent: the vent's blast carries him higher. Offered when a vent prop (World's) is within withinBh of the target. The launch's up force is times liftMul
VENT LIFT._onUppercut: Encounter, biomes W3: the score is the vent's on top of UPPERCUT's own there (10, and 12 more under 120 units up), since VENT LIFT is an uppercut over a vent. Alone, 12 never beat the plain uppercut beside it (0 of 16 launches in the W3 probe). For Game Design to confirm

PROP SMASH._about: a send into one big prop on the line: a lone tree, a rock outcrop, a boulder or a berg, the way BUILDING SMASH takes a building but with no people and no chain. Offered when such a prop stands on the predicted line within reachBh. The prop breaks (World) and the body stops at it
PROP SMASH.where: savanna, highland, tundra, sea ice; any biome where World places such props

sends._about: added to launch.gd SENDS, so a piece that names where it sends (launch enders, the stick's aim) keeps these too
